AykutSarac/jsoncrack.com
https://github.com/AykutSarac/jsoncrack.com
Apache-2.0, Copyright 2025 Aykut Saraç

Upstream is a Next.js / Turborepo app (apps/www) plus a React embed
(packages/jsoncrack-react). That stack cannot ride in as classic scripts.

This directory is the port of the GRAPH VIEW: the same node rule (an
object or array is a card; nested objects/arrays become children with
an edge labelled by the key; primitives stay on the parent card), a
left-to-right layout, pan and zoom. The editor is a textarea. Accounts,
cloud, VS Code, Chrome extras and ToDiagram are not shipped.

The document is saved on this device. Press Invite to show the same
document in a meeting. Upstream is a public website.
